title: Vietnamese Grilled Pork Buns
description: A sweet and savory Vietnamese-inspired street food dish featuring grilled pork and steamed buns. Serve immediately for the best experience.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together grilling sauce, hoisin sauce, sriracha, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the sliced pork, making sure to coat evenly.
Grill the pork for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
While the pork is cooking, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
Once the pork is cooked, let it rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Assemble the buns by spreading a layer of pickled carrots and daikon on the bottom bun.
Add a few slices of the grilled pork on top of the pickled vegetables.
Drizzle a small amount of hoisin sauce on top of the pork, if using.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro on top of the pork for garnish.
